about: Dictation benchmark corpus: invented German practice-style sentences, no patient data. `spoken` is one entry per dictation (one fn press); the real-voice recording is <id>.wav for one dictation, <id>-1.wav, <id>-2.wav … for several. `say` is the same text spelled for the macOS `say` voices where they would mispronounce it. `expected` / `alternatives` is the spokenOnly ("Nur gesprochen") result, `automatic` / `automaticAlternatives` the Automatic one (absent: not scored). `terms` are glossary words the output must contain exactly; every glossary word NOT in `terms` must be absent. Numbers are accepted as digits or words through `alternatives`, because Parakeet writes either.
